name: Société BIC SA
summary: Société BIC SA manufactures and sells stationery, lighter, shaver, and other products worldwide. It offers ballpoint, gel ink, erasable ink, writing felt-tip, learning to write, and fountain pens; mechanical and graphite pencils; proofreaders, glues, erasers, compasses, scissors, pencil sharpeners, notebooks and diaries, and other accessories; and refills. The company also provides coloring markers, colored pencils, kits and boxes, paint markers, highlighters and whiteboards permanent, and dry-erase markers.
